content: 1. Ensure that you adhere strictly to the prescribed schedule for taking this medication. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. 2. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and heat. Do not store it in the bathroom, and ensure it is kept below 104°F (40°C). 3. Do not dispose of this medication by flushing it down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard the product when it is expired or no longer needed. 4. This medication is typically administered via injection into a vein by a healthcare professional. It is usually given 2 to 3 times daily for the first 2 to 3 weeks of treatment, followed by once-daily administration. The infusion is generally performed slowly over 1 to 2 hours using an infusion pump. 5. If you are using this medication at home, ensure you are thoroughly trained by your healthcare provider on preparation and administration techniques. Do not mix this medication with any other drugs. 6. Before using this medication, visually inspect it for particles or discoloration. If you notice any abnormalities, do not use the product. 7. To prevent kidney damage, it is essential to maintain adequate hydration by drinking plenty of fluids while on this medication. 8. Antiviral medications are most effective when their levels in the body are kept constant. Therefore, it is crucial to use this medication exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Do not use more of the drug, infuse it more frequently, or administer it faster than directed. 9. If the medication comes into contact with your skin, rinse the area thoroughly with plenty of water. 10. Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, headache, diarrhea, dizziness, or swelling/pain at the injection site. These effects are generally mild, but if they persist or worsen, contact your healthcare provider. 11. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare but can occur. 12. If you experience symptoms of a severe allergic reaction, such as rash, itching/swelling (especially of the face/tongue/throat), severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing, seek immediate medical attention. 13. This document does not provide a comprehensive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for guidance. 14. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. 15. This medication may cause dizziness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks requiring alertness until you are sure you can do so safely. Limit alcoholic beverages. 16. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk. Due to potential risks to the infant, breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. 17. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription/nonprescription drugs and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 18. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about potential interactions. 19. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. 20. This medication is typically first administered in a hospital setting, where your condition can be closely monitored. 21. While using this medication, regular laboratory and/or medical tests (such as kidney function, electrolyte levels, complete blood count, and eye exams) should be conducted to monitor your progress and detect any potential side effects. 22. Keep all medical and laboratory appointments as scheduled to ensure proper monitoring and management of your treatment.
